en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing the ruins of a large stone structure with three arched windows, partially covered by overgrown vegetation. In the foreground, there is a traditional wooden house with a steeply pitched roof. The setting appears rural, with trees and grass surrounding the buildings. The text at the top reads 'Hamar, Domkirken. Ruinerne fra Vest.'
